0022600129.text: The Pistons come into this 4th game of their season at 3-0, first in the Central and first in the East, while the Knicks are 0-3, fourth in the Atlantic and 2.5 games back, and 12th in the East. Detroit won all three meetings between these teams in 2025-26, most recently 126-111 in New York on February 19, 2026, and they have not met yet this season. Ausar Thompson (ankle sprain) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain) are out for Detroit, and Isaiah Joe is day-to-day with a hip bruise, while Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain) is out for New York.
